title: VIVE Focus Vision
body_html:
A hybrid standalone 5K PC-VR headset featuring built-in eye tracking, a hot-swappable battery, and full-body tracking support*—completely base station-free.

View product details and specs ›

 

*VIVE Wired Streaming Cable Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible), VIVE Facial Tracker, and VIVE Ultimate Trackers sold separately.

 

Helpful information

1. PC VR content is accessible via VIVE Streaming within VIVE Hub on PC. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. Latency and visual quality of VR/MR content are dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection. Verify your PC meets the requirements for Streaming. Connect your computer directly to your Wi-Fi router using an Ethernet cable for PC VR streaming. To connect to a PC via DisplayPort, VIVE Focus Vision also requires VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible) and VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible), both of which are included in VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible). VIVE Wired Streaming Kit sold separately.

2. Content compatibility required. Please check the specifications to ensure the content supports eye tracking and related functions like foveated rendering. Performance may vary by title or application and may be affected by eye surgery, eye disease, heavy makeup, and/or high myopia

3. Hand tracking features are VR title dependent. Check the VR title's description for compatible inputs or use a filtered search for hand tracking-enabled content.

4. The precision of the auto-IPD adjustment may vary from user to user.

5. Depth-sensing-enabled features are limited to indoor environments. Available virtual interactions using scene understanding are dependent on content compatibility.

6. The front internal battery is only intended to sustain power long enough for the rear battery to be swapped with a freshly charged VIVE Battery for Focus Series, and for no more than 20 minutes at a time. Please see the user guide for instructions on swapping the rear battery correctly.

7. VIVE Desk is accessible within VIVE Hub on PC. System requirements must be met. PC required. Visual quality of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.

8. VIVE Ultimate Trackers sold separately. Content compatibility required.

9. MicroSD card not included.

10. Wi-Fi 6E support is country dependent. For more details visit manufacturer's support site.

11. 120 Hz PC VR support via DisplayPort mode.

12. Glasses must be able to fit within the 150 mm wide facial interface, and the gasket spacer included in the box may need to be attached to the headset to provide sufficient depth. In some cases, the wide version of the gasket spacer may be needed. Availability varies by region.

13. All battery claim results will vary. Battery life and charge cycles vary by use.

14. VIVE Wired Streaming Kit supports VIVE Focus Vision headset. System requirements must be met. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. Visual quality and low latency of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.
